title: Name the house duality built
summary: Duality builds a whole inner house for ego to inhabit. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Duality builds a whole inner house for ego to inhabit.
source.lifeApplication: When you feel divided, name the second allegiance before it starts feeling normal.
